note: Mississippi U.S. Senate race, researched Oct. 25, 2026.

candidates.name: Cindy Hyde-Smith
candidates.bio: U.S. senator since 2018 and a former Mississippi agriculture commissioner.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith chairs the Senate Pro-Life Caucus and opposes taxpayer funding of abortion
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith says unborn children have a right to life from their Creator
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted to end the clean energy tax credits (Senate roll call 372, 2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith supported incentives for a new electric vehicle battery plant in Mississippi
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith supports the administration's push for more oil drilling
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith criticizes Democratic climate policy
source.quote: Democrats' radical Green New Deal climate agenda

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted to end mining limits near the Boundary Waters (Senate roll call 84, 2026) and seeks repeal of a gasoline vapor testing rule
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith secured federal funding for law enforcement technology and training (2024)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted against the infrastructure law (Senate roll call 314, 2021)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith called for farm aid after commodity prices fell
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith introduced the Buying American Cotton Act, a tax credit for products made with U.S. cotton (S. 1919)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith says Washington should support states' schools without dictating to them
source.quote: should not dictate how they get the job done

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith supported a $600,000 federal grant for Mississippi charter schools (2023)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted for the 2025 law that cut Medicaid (Senate roll call 372)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted against extending the ACA tax credits (Senate roll call 644, 2025)

guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted to extend the 2017 tax cuts (2025), though she also voted for a tax increase on the ultrawealthy to help rural hospitals (Senate roll call 355, 2025)
source.quote: helping unleash a wave of prosperity across America

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith supports the border wall
source.quote: secure its borders and control who enters our country

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith introduced a bill requiring all employers to use E-Verify
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith says ICE is pursuing law and order (WLOX, Feb. 2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted against requiring congressional authorization for military action in Iran (Senate roll call 46, 2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith opposed limiting the Iran war
source.quote: embolden our enemies and endanger our brave fighting men and women

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith voted against the Respect for Marriage Act (Senate roll call 362, 2022)
source.quote: believe in the traditional definition of marriage

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith introduced a resolution defining sex as biological sex at birth (S.Res. 53) and opposes transgender girls in girls' sports
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith calls tariffs a really good tool against unfair trade
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Hyde-Smith supports voter ID and proof of citizenship to register
source.quote: It is lawful, it is fair, and it works.

candidates.name: Scott Colom
candidates.bio: District attorney for Mississippi's 16th Circuit Court District since 2016.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom calls himself pro-life as a Christian but would trust women to make their own choices, and supports IVF access
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: As district attorney, Colom expanded pretrial diversion and started Mississippi's first restorative justice program
source.quote: alternatives to incarceration for young people

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom would end income tax for teachers and police officers earning under $75,000
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom criticized the 2025 federal funding freeze that cut $137 million from Mississippi schools
source.quote: fewer resources, fewer safeguards, and more young lives at risk

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom supports expanding Medicaid
source.quote: We have to cancel those healthcare cuts.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom supports extending the ACA tax credits
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom says President Trump has done a good job securing the border
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom opposes H-1B visas, saying companies replace American workers with foreign ones
source.quote: those jobs need to be in Mississippi

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom says the Constitution requires Congress to declare war
guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom on Iran
source.quote: I don't know what the objective is right now in the war in Iran.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom says biological boys shouldn't play girls' sports but in 2021 opposed criminalizing gender-affirming care
source.quote: We should not criminalize people's identity.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom says the minimum wage hasn't risen in nearly 20 years
source.quote: when you raise the minimum wage, you boost all wages

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom says tariffs raise prices and hurt farmers, and that Congress should set them
source.quote: Tariffs have been terrible for Mississippi.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom criticized extending the 2017 tax cuts
source.quote: a permanent tax handout to people making more than $600,000 a year

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Mississippi U.S. Senate voters guide: Colom opposes Mississippi's 2026 law checking new voters' citizenship against a federal database
